info.title: Native - Arp (augmented)
info.description:
Cisco IOS XE Native Configuration — `/native/arp` subtree, added to the /native root by sibling YANG module(s) via `augment "/ios:native"`. Origin module(s): Cisco-IOS-XE-arp.

**Paths:** 7
**HTTP methods:** GET / PUT / PATCH / DELETE
